verses.literal: And now this decree is for you O priests
verses.literalPt: Agora, para vós, ó sacerdotes, é este mandamento.

verses.original: אִם־ לֹ֣א תִשְׁמְע֡וּ וְאִם־ לֹא֩ תָשִׂ֨ימוּ עַל־ לֵ֜ב לָתֵ֧ת כָּב֣וֹד לִשְׁמִ֗י אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֤י בָכֶם֙ אֶת־ הַמְּאֵרָ֔ה וְאָרוֹתִ֖י אֶת־ בִּרְכֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְגַם֙ אָרוֹתִ֔יהָ כִּ֥י אֵינְכֶ֖ם שָׂמִ֥ים עַל־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- lō ṯiš·mə·‘ū wə·’im- lō ṯā·śî·mū ‘al- lêḇ lā·ṯêṯ kā·ḇō·wḏ liš·mî ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ wə·šil·laḥ·tî ḇā·ḵem ’eṯ- ham·mə·’ê·rāh wə·’ā·rō·w·ṯî ’eṯ- bir·ḵō·w·ṯê·ḵem wə·ḡam ’ā·rō·w·ṯî·hā kî ’ê·nə·ḵem śā·mîm ‘al- lêḇ
verses.literal: If you do not listen and if you do not take it to heart to honor . . . My name says the LORD of Hosts I will send a curse among you and I will curse your blessings Yes I have already begun to curse them because you are not taking it to heart
verses.literalPt: Se não ouvirdes e se não aplicardes o vosso coração a dar glória ao meu nome, diz Jeová dos Exércitos, enviarei sobre vós a maldição e amaldiçoarei as vossas bênçãos; já as tenho amaldiçoado, porque não aplicais a isso o vosso coração.

verses.original: הִנְנִ֨י גֹעֵ֤ר לָכֶם֙ אֶת־ הַזֶּ֔רַע וְזֵרִ֤יתִי פֶ֙רֶשׁ֙ עַל־ פְּנֵיכֶ֔ם פֶּ֖רֶשׁ חַגֵּיכֶ֑ם וְנָשָׂ֥א אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî ḡō·‘êr lā·ḵem ’eṯ- haz·ze·ra‘ wə·zê·rî·ṯî p̄e·reš ‘al- pə·nê·ḵem pe·reš ḥag·gê·ḵem wə·nā·śā ’eṯ·ḵem ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: Behold I will rebuke your descendants and I will spread dung on your faces the waste from your feasts and you will be carried off with it
verses.literalPt: Eis que reprovarei a semente por causa de vós e atirar-vos-ei à cara com o esterco, sim, com o esterco dos vossos sacrifícios; e juntamente com ele sereis levados.

verses.original: וִֽידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֚י שִׁלַּ֣חְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת הַמִּצְוָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את לִֽהְי֤וֹת בְּרִיתִי֙ אֶת־ לֵוִ֔י אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wî·ḏa‘·tem kî šil·laḥ·tî ’ă·lê·ḵem ’êṯ ham·miṣ·wāh haz·zōṯ lih·yō·wṯ bə·rî·ṯî ’eṯ- lê·wî ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then you will know that I have sent you this commandment so that My covenant with Levi may continue says the LORD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: Sabereis que vos enviei este mandamento, para que a minha aliança fosse com Levi, diz Jeová dos Exércitos.

verses.original: בְּרִיתִ֣י׀ הָיְתָ֣ה אִתּ֗וֹ הַֽחַיִּים֙ וְהַ֨שָּׁל֔וֹם וָאֶתְּנֵֽם־ ל֥וֹ מוֹרָ֖א וַיִּֽירָאֵ֑נִי וּמִפְּנֵ֥י שְׁמִ֖י נִחַ֥ת הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rî·ṯî hā·yə·ṯāh ’it·tōw ha·ḥay·yîm wə·haš·šā·lō·wm wā·’et·tə·nêm- lōw mō·w·rā way·yî·rā·’ê·nî ū·mip·pə·nê šə·mî ni·ḥaṯ hū
verses.literal: My covenant with him was one of life and peace which I gave to him it called for reverence and he revered Me and stood in awe . . . . . . of My name
verses.literalPt: A minha aliança com ele foi de vida e de paz; eu lhas dei para que me temesse, e ele me temeu e teve medo do meu nome.

verses.original: תּוֹרַ֤ת אֱמֶת֙ הָיְתָ֣ה בְּפִ֔יהוּ וְעַוְלָ֖ה לֹא־ נִמְצָ֣א בִשְׂפָתָ֑יו בְּשָׁל֤וֹם וּבְמִישׁוֹר֙ הָלַ֣ךְ אִתִּ֔י וְרַבִּ֖ים הֵשִׁ֥יב מֵעָוֺֽן׃
verses.transliteration: tō·w·raṯ ’ĕ·meṯ hā·yə·ṯāh bə·p̄î·hū wə·‘aw·lāh lō- nim·ṣā ḇiś·p̄ā·ṯāw bə·šā·lō·wm ū·ḇə·mî·šō·wr hā·laḵ ’it·tî wə·rab·bîm hê·šîḇ mê·‘ā·wōn
verses.literal: True instruction was in his mouth and nothing false was found on his lips He walked with Me in peace and uprightness and he turned many from iniquity
verses.literalPt: A lei da verdade esteve na sua boca, e a injustiça não se achou nos seus lábios; ele andou comigo em paz e em equidade e da iniquidade apartou a muitos.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ שִׂפְתֵ֤י כֹהֵן֙ יִשְׁמְרוּ־ דַ֔עַת וְתוֹרָ֖ה יְבַקְשׁ֣וּ מִפִּ֑יהוּ כִּ֛י מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָֽה־ צְבָא֖וֹת הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: kî- śip̄·ṯê ḵō·hên yiš·mə·rū- ḏa·‘aṯ wə·ṯō·w·rāh yə·ḇaq·šū mip·pî·hū kî mal·’aḵ Yah·weh- ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ hū
verses.literal: For the lips of a priest should preserve knowledge and people should seek instruction from his mouth because he is the messenger of the LORD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: Pois os lábios do sacerdote devem guardar a ciência, e da sua boca devem os homens procurar a lei; porque ele é o mensageiro de Jeová dos Exércitos.

verses.original: וְאַתֶּם֙ סַרְתֶּ֣ם מִן־ הַדֶּ֔רֶךְ הִכְשַׁלְתֶּ֥ם רַבִּ֖ים בַּתּוֹרָ֑ה שִֽׁחַתֶּם֙ בְּרִ֣ית הַלֵּוִ֔י אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tem sar·tem min- had·de·reḵ hiḵ·šal·tem rab·bîm bat·tō·w·rāh ši·ḥat·tem bə·rîṯ hal·lê·wî ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: But you have departed from the way and your instruction has caused many to stumble You have violated the covenant of Levi says the LORD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: Mas vós vos tendes desviado do caminho; e tendes feito a muitos tropeçar na lei; tendes corrompido a aliança de Levi, diz Jeová dos Exércitos.

verses.original: וְגַם־ אֲנִ֞י נָתַ֧תִּי אֶתְכֶ֛ם נִבְזִ֥ים וּשְׁפָלִ֖ים לְכָל־ הָעָ֑ם כְּפִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵֽינְכֶם֙ שֹׁמְרִ֣ים אֶת־ דְּרָכַ֔י וְנֹשְׂאִ֥ים פָּנִ֖ים בַּתּוֹרָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- ’ă·nî nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ·ḵem niḇ·zîm ū·šə·p̄ā·lîm lə·ḵāl hā·‘ām kə·p̄î ’ă·šer ’ê·nə·ḵem šō·mə·rîm ’eṯ- də·rā·ḵay wə·nō·śə·’îm pā·nîm bat·tō·w·rāh
verses.literal: So I in turn have made you despised and humiliated before all the people because you have not kept My ways but have shown partiality . . . in matters of the law
verses.literalPt: Portanto, também eu vos tenho feito desprezíveis e vis diante de todo o povo, assim como vós não tendes observado os meus caminhos, mas vos tendes deixado levar de respeitos humanos na lei.

verses.original: הֲל֨וֹא אָ֤ב אֶחָד֙ לְכֻלָּ֔נוּ הֲל֛וֹא אֵ֥ל אֶֽחָ֖ד בְּרָאָ֑נוּ מַדּ֗וּעַ נִבְגַּד֙ אִ֣ישׁ בְּאָחִ֔יו לְחַלֵּ֖ל בְּרִ֥ית אֲבֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w ’āḇ ’e·ḥāḏ lə·ḵul·lā·nū hă·lō·w ’êl ’e·ḥāḏ bə·rā·’ā·nū mad·dū·a‘ niḇ·gaḏ ’îš bə·’ā·ḥîw lə·ḥal·lêl bə·rîṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: Do we not all have one Father Did not one God create us Why then do we break faith with one another so as to profane the covenant of our fathers
verses.literalPt: Não temos todos nós um mesmo pai? Não nos criou um mesmo Deus? Por que nos havemos aleivosamente, cada um com seu irmão, profanando a aliança de nossos pais?

verses.original: בָּגְדָ֣ה יְהוּדָ֔ה וְתוֹעֵבָ֛ה נֶעֶשְׂתָ֥ה בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּבִירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּ֣י׀ חִלֵּ֣ל יְהוּדָ֗ה קֹ֤דֶשׁ יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהֵ֔ב וּבָעַ֖ל בַּת־ אֵ֥ל נֵכָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: bā·ḡə·ḏāh yə·hū·ḏāh wə·ṯō·w·‘ê·ḇāh ne·‘eś·ṯāh ḇə·yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇî·rū·šā·lim kî ḥil·lêl yə·hū·ḏāh qō·ḏeš Yah·weh ’ă·šer ’ā·hêḇ ū·ḇā·‘al baṯ- ’êl nê·ḵār
verses.literal: Judah has broken faith an abomination has been committed in Israel and in Jerusalem For Judah has profaned the LORD’s beloved sanctuary by marrying the daughter of a foreign god
verses.literalPt: Judá se tem havido aleivosamente; e uma abominação se comete em Israel e em Jerusalém; porque Judá tem profanado a santidade de Jeová, a qual ele ama, e se casou com a filha dum deus estranho.

verses.original: יַכְרֵ֨ת יְהוָ֜ה לָאִ֨ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַעֲשֶׂ֙נָּה֙ עֵ֣ר וְעֹנֶ֔ה מֵאָהֳלֵ֖י יַֽעֲקֹ֑ב וּמַגִּ֣ישׁ מִנְחָ֔ה לַֽיהוָ֖ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: yaḵ·rêṯ Yah·weh lā·’îš ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·śen·nāh ‘êr wə·‘ō·neh mê·’ā·ho·lê ya·‘ă·qōḇ ū·mag·gîš min·ḥāh Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: As for the man who does this may the LORD cut off from the tents of Jacob everyone who is awake and aware even if he brings an offering to the LORD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: No caso do homem que fizer isso, Jeová exterminará das tendas de Jacó o que vela, e o que responde, e o que faz ofertas a Jeová dos Exércitos.

verses.original: וְזֹאת֙ שֵׁנִ֣ית תַּֽעֲשׂ֔וּ כַּסּ֤וֹת דִּמְעָה֙ אֶת־ מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה בְּכִ֖י וַֽאֲנָקָ֑ה מֵאֵ֣ין ע֗וֹד פְּנוֹת֙ אֶל־ הַמִּנְחָ֔ה וְלָקַ֥חַת רָצ֖וֹן מִיֶּדְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zōṯ šê·nîṯ ta·‘ă·śū kas·sō·wṯ dim·‘āh ’eṯ- miz·baḥ Yah·weh bə·ḵî wa·’ă·nā·qāh mê·’ên ‘ō·wḏ pə·nō·wṯ ’el- ham·min·ḥāh wə·lā·qa·ḥaṯ rā·ṣō·wn mî·yeḏ·ḵem
verses.literal: And this is another thing you do You cover the altar of the LORD with tears with weeping and groaning because He no longer regards . . . your offerings or receives them gladly from your hands
verses.literalPt: Ainda fazeis mais isto: cobris de lágrimas, de choro e de gemidos o altar de Jeová, de sorte que ele não olha mais para a oferta, nem a aceitará com prazer da vossa mão.

verses.original: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם עַל־ מָ֑ה עַ֡ל כִּי־ יְהוָה֩ הֵעִ֨יד בֵּינְךָ֜ וּבֵ֣ין׀ אֵ֣שֶׁת נְעוּרֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ בָּגַ֣דְתָּה בָּ֔הּ וְהִ֥יא חֲבֶרְתְּךָ֖ וְאֵ֥שֶׁת בְּרִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·mar·tem ‘al- māh ‘al kî- Yah·weh hê·‘îḏ bê·nə·ḵā ū·ḇên ’ê·šeṯ nə·‘ū·re·ḵā ’ă·šer ’at·tāh bā·ḡaḏ·tāh bāh wə·hî ḥă·ḇer·tə·ḵā wə·’ê·šeṯ bə·rî·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Yet you ask Why . . . It is because . . . the LORD has been a witness between you and the wife of your youth against whom you have broken faith though she is your companion and your wife by covenant
verses.literalPt: Todavia dizeis: Por quê? Porque Jeová tem sido testemunha entre ti e a mulher da tua mocidade, contra a qual te hás havido aleivosamente, sendo ela a tua companheira e a mulher da tua aliança.

verses.original: וְלֹא־ אֶחָ֣ד עָשָׂ֗ה וּשְׁאָ֥ר ר֙וּחַ֙ ל֔וֹ וּמָה֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד מְבַקֵּ֖שׁ זֶ֣רַע אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ בְּר֣וּחֲכֶ֔ם וּבְאֵ֥שֶׁת נְעוּרֶ֖יךָ אַל־ יִבְגֹּֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ’e·ḥāḏ ‘ā·śāh ū·šə·’ār rū·aḥ lōw ū·māh hā·’e·ḥāḏ mə·ḇaq·qêš ze·ra‘ ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·niš·mar·tem bə·rū·ḥă·ḵem ū·ḇə·’ê·šeṯ nə·‘ū·re·ḵā ’al- yiḇ·gōḏ
verses.literal: Has not the LORD made them one having a portion of the Spirit And why one Because He seeks godly offspring So guard yourselves in your spirit and do not break faith with the wife of your youth
verses.literalPt: Não fez ele somente um, ainda que lhe sobrava o espírito? E por que somente esse um? Ele buscava uma semente pia. Portanto, guardai o vosso espírito, e não se haja alguém aleivosamente contra a mulher da sua mocidade.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ שָׂנֵ֣א שַׁלַּ֗ח אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְכִסָּ֤ה חָמָס֙ עַל־ לְבוּשׁ֔וֹ אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם בְּרוּחֲכֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א תִבְגֹּֽדוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- śā·nê šal·laḥ ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl wə·ḵis·sāh ḥā·mās ‘al- lə·ḇū·šōw ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ wə·niš·mar·tem bə·rū·ḥă·ḵem wə·lō ṯiḇ·gō·ḏū
verses.literal: For I hate divorce says the LORD the God of Israel He who divorces his wife covers his garment with violence says the LORD of Hosts So guard yourselves in your spirit and do not break faith
verses.literalPt: Pois aborreço o divórcio, diz Jeová, Deus de Israel, e aquele que cobre de violência os seus vestidos, diz Jeová dos Exércitos. Portanto, guardai o vosso espírito, para que não vos hajais aleivosamente.

verses.original: הוֹגַעְתֶּ֤ם יְהוָה֙ בְּדִבְרֵיכֶ֔ם וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בַּמָּ֣ה הוֹגָ֑עְנוּ בֶּאֱמָרְכֶ֗ם כָּל־ עֹ֨שֵׂה רָ֜ע ט֣וֹב׀ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה וּבָהֶם֙ ה֣וּא חָפֵ֔ץ א֥וֹ אַיֵּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḡa‘·tem Yah·weh bə·ḏiḇ·rê·ḵem wa·’ă·mar·tem bam·māh hō·w·ḡā·‘ə·nū be·’ĕ·mā·rə·ḵem kāl- ‘ō·śêh rā‘ ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh ū·ḇā·hem hū ḥā·p̄êṣ ’ōw ’ay·yêh ’ĕ·lō·hê ham·miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: You have wearied the LORD with your words yet you ask How have we wearied Him By saying All who do evil are good in the sight of the LORD and in them He delights or Where is the God of justice
verses.literalPt: Tendes enfadado a Jeová com as vossas palavras. Todavia dizeis: Em que o temos enfadado? Nisto que dizeis: Todo o que faz o mal é bom aos olhos de Jeová, e nestes tais ele se deleita; ou onde está o Deus do juízo?
